data.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Coinbase
data.about:
My experience spans developing APIs, SDKs, applications and web applications, with competence in technologies like Java, Golang, TypeScript, React, C#, C, ASP.NET, .NET Core, Tailwind CSS, HTML. And tools like AWS, Docker, Datadog, Stripe, Figma, HubSpot, Intercom.

Bachelor with academic honors in Software Engineering at Pontifícia Universidade Católica do Rio Grande do Sul. Awarded Outstanding Academic by the university and Outstanding Student by the Brazilian Computer Society. With experience in Back-end, Front-end and Full Stack roles, I've had the privilege of working on innovative projects across different industries, including software development at SAP, e-Core, and Trinsic. I’ve also contributed to developer communities as a Developer Advocate, organizing events and creating technical content to support and engage other developers.

I’m a communicative developer with strong interpersonal skills, motivated by goals and objectives. I’m motivated by goals and objectives, and I take pride in being hardworking, curious, and a fast learner. I really enjoy working in teams where I can collaborate and learn from others, but I also excel at diving into individual tasks. My colleagues often say I bring cheerfulness to the team, which is something I value a lot.

I’m excited about what’s next and looking forward to growing in an environment where I can contribute to impactful projects and continue to learn and develop myself.

description.text:
AI-Powered Customer Support Platform
- Led the development of an internal AI-powered customer support platform from the ground up, building both frontend (React/TypeScript) and backend (Go) components
- Designed and implemented core platform capabilities including a multi-chat workspace integrated with Amazon Connect Streams API and LLM-powered response suggestions based on live customer conversations and Coinbase internal knowledge sources
- Rolled out the platform to 1,500 support agents, improving productivity and support efficiency while helping replace legacy tooling and reduce annual Salesforce licensing costs by more than $1.3M
- Implemented and expanded automated testing strategies to reduce regressions and improve release confidence

Financial Crime & Risk Investigation Platform
- Developed frontend (React/TypeScript) and backend (Go) features for an internal investigation platform used by compliance and risk operations teams to review potentially suspicious customer activity
- Delivered new workflows, integrations, and platform enhancements that improved investigators' access to customer account information, behavioral signals, transaction history, and case data for risk assessments
- Contributed to AI-assisted investigation capabilities, including LLM-generated customer summaries that reduced manual review effort and accelerated decision-making
- Improved platform reliability by resolving production issues, correcting workflow inconsistencies, and addressing performance bottlenecks
- Collaborated closely with compliance, operations, product, and engineering teams to deliver solutions supporting regulatory and operational requirements

Trinsic is a seed-funded American startup that provides a SaaS infrastructure platform, SDKs and products that enable reusable and verifiable digital identities and the creation of the first identity acceptance network
- Played a pivotal role as a Full Stack developer, developing and launching over 3 new products within a year. Collaborated closely with product and design teams to deliver effective solutions
- Developed back-end services in C# and ASP.NET, including APIs and SDKs, to enable seamless customer integration and enhance product functionality
- Took charge of updating and componentizing the legacy product according to the designs, resulting in improved user experience and simplified maintenance. Developed the front-end of new products using TypeScript, React, Tailwind, and React Hooks, among other libraries
- Participated in biannual team-building trips to the USA with a 1-week stay in the same accommodation with all company colleagues, engaging in face-to-face work, hackathons, brainstorming sessions, and performance reviews, fostering collaboration and strengthening team dynamics

- Responsible for fostering and engaging the developer community on Slack, organizing meetups and online events, and providing support for product implementation and Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and Software Development Kits (SDKs) usage, enhancing community interaction and customer integration
- Collected feedback from the community and developed the related improvements, resolved bugs and technical issues, and created a product FAQ. Maintained up-to-date documentation by creating code samples, project guides, API references, blog posts, and other technical content. These efforts reduced customer queries and improved user experience by providing clear, accessible information
